summary: End-to-end verification of FINORA two-tier e-contract feature (Tier B CONSULTING + Tier A FINORA_SAAS). 27/27 pytest cases pass, covering: state machine (statement→confirm→agreement→recipient sign→issuer sign→ACTIVE with 409/403 on out-of-order or wrong-role calls), doc integrity (SHA-256), evidence trail (ip/user_agent/party/CONFIRM/SIGN acts), PDF generation (%PDF, Portuguese), auto-DRAFT invoice on B ACTIVE, billing_contract creation, client 'contract' document, amendment (v1→ENDED AMENDED, v2 ACTIVE), /end with billing_contract ENDED, tenant isolation (client_a, consultantb → 404), legacy /api/data/contracts POST 403, signup auto-sends FINORA statement, gated endpoints (clients/invitations 403 before A ACTIVE), A end with consultant_login=blocked → login 403. UI verified on preview: sidebar-nav-my_contracts, /my-contracts ec-group-* grouped list, ec-stepper, ec-confirm-check + ec-confirm-btn (client), ec-sign-name + ec-signature-pad (canvas mouse drag) + ec-sign-agree + ec-sign-submit → FIRST_PARTY_SIGNED, ec-issuer-sign-card (admin) → ACTIVE, ec-pdf-important/ec-pdf-agreement visible, ClientDetail 契約 tab → ec-panel-CONSULTING + ec-new-btn opens econtract-form with ec-service/ec-fee/ec-save, /platform platform-tab-ec_consultant_contracts lists FINORA contracts. Mobile 390px /econtracts/:id has 0px horizontal overflow.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid was 'signature-pad'/'signature-clear' but spec requires 'ec-signature-pad'/'ec-signature-clear'. Fixed by testing agent.

issues: Hydration warning: <span> inside <option> (React DevTools instrumentation, harmless — pre-existing from iteration_9/10).

critical_code_review_comments: econtract.py state machine is well-guarded: _move() uses find_one_and_update with $in status filter — atomic and race-free. Good.
load() correctly hides DRAFT from client role and returns 404 for cross-tenant/cross-client access (verified).
is_issuer/is_recipient split cleanly by contract_type; FINORA_SAAS confirm auto-issues agreement inside /confirm — good UX shortcut.
_activate() writes PDF to GridFS, links pdf_file_id on econtract_docs, and mirrors into documents collection with category='contract' — correct.
Amendment: parent superseded_by + status ENDED with end_reason=AMENDED works; billing_contract ENDED cascade OK.

Signup gate: tenants.finora_contract_required=True + finora_contract!='ACTIVE' blocks require_service; verified via /api/data/clients POST and /api/invitations POST both 403 before A ACTIVE, both allowed after.
auth_routes.end_policy check returns 403 for a consultant with tenant.finora_contract='ENDED' and end_policy.consultant_login='blocked' — verified.
Consistency: FS-* counter uses tenant='platform' so no collision across tenants; CC-* per-tenant. Good.
SignaturePad component still uses onPointerDown/Move/Up — works in Playwright by dispatching mouse events (page.mouse.down/move); confirmed.
